content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

When conventional payment platforms restrict access or impose high fees, you need an architecture that guarantees sovereignty over your digital sales. Traditional services often fail in regions with unstable currencies or regulatory limitations. COREMERCH's infrastructure is built for the unique challenges faced by creators in these areas. By leveraging free tools like Cloudflare and Google Apps Script, you can create a self-hosted store that gives you control over your revenue and customer data. Unlike relying on platforms that could change their policies at any time, this approach ensures you are not dependent on external services for your income.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can launch your digital store, gather the essential components of your sovereign stack. First, you need a domain name to establish your online presence. Next, set up a free hosting account with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. You'll also need a NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrency payments efficiently. Prepare your digital products—whether they are ebooks, courses, or software—and ensure they are ready for delivery. Finally, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automating product delivery and payment confirmation. With these pieces in place, you are ready to deploy your infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Your payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for ensuring customers receive their products promptly after purchase. Start by integrating NOWPayments with your chosen payment method, allowing for over 300 cryptocurrencies to be accepted with a minimal fee of 0.5%. Next, use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate product delivery. This setup will allow you to trigger file access once payment is confirmed on-chain. The combination of these tools ensures a seamless transaction experience for your customers, eliminating the waiting periods often associated with conventional platforms.
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale; you pay only 0.5% with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is ready and tested, it's time to go live. Promote your digital store through social media and other channels relevant to your audience. When a customer makes a purchase, ensure that your NOWPayments integration works flawlessly. Monitor the transaction and confirm that the automated delivery process kicks in as expected. This is your opportunity to refine your system based on real-world feedback. If any issues arise, use your support resources to troubleshoot effectively. Achieving your first successful transaction will validate the robustness of your sovereign stack.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing a successful foundation, consider scaling your operations. Review your product offerings and customer feedback to identify new opportunities for growth. You can expand your inventory or refine your marketing strategies. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that facilitate further development of your digital commerce stack. Implementing automation and analytics tools will help you track performance and optimize your sales processes. With your sovereign infrastructure, you’re well-positioned to grow without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use a self-hosted solution with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This approach allows you to bypass platform fees, retaining more profits from each sale. With a setup costing as low as $97 for the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can start generating income immediately.
At 100 sales per month, you retain an additional $921 by using our infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by setting up a sovereign stack. Use NOWPayments for processing crypto payments, which eliminates the need for PayPal or Stripe, allowing you to retain more of your earnings.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to use a self-hosted solution with tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments. This method significantly reduces fees to just 0.5% per transaction, compared to higher charges from platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by deploying your own digital commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts independently. This setup gives you full control over your sales and eliminates reliance on platforms with high fees.
What tools do I need to set up my digital store?
You need a domain name, a hosting account with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a NOWPayments account, and a delivery automation tool like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers.
How can I ensure a seamless payment process?

To ensure a seamless payment process, integrate NOWPayments correctly and automate product delivery via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This guarantees that customers receive their products immediately after a confirmed payment.
Ownership of your store means no more dependency on restrictive platforms.
